text:
emma: Quick UX smoke: on tiny screens the console's left rail (icon-only) sometimes overlaps the table row's inline actions. Reported from a user on iPhone SE.

raj: thanks, can you drop repro steps + device?

emma: Console > Pipelines > Recent > shrink width to 320px in simulator, try to tap the kebab on a row. The rail visually sits above the row and intercepts taps. Short video: https://redwood-internal/caps/rail-overlap-320.mp4

lucas: this is familiar. Likely a stacking context from transform: translateZ on the rail. We also lost the 44px touch target in compact rows.

mia: design ideas: A) collapse to a full-screen drawer under 360px, B) keep icon rail but move per-row actions to a centered popover, C) inline expand row to reveal actions. I prefer centered popover — keeps context and avoids focus-trap complexity.

raj: centered popover sounds safe. Dev notes: render popovers into a portal (document.body) to escape stacking contexts, and ensure min touch area for icons.

lucas: quick CSS I prototyped:
```
@media (max-width: 360px) {
  .app-rail { transform: none; }
  .row .kebab { min-width:44px; min-height:44px; padding:6px; }
  .popover-portal { position: fixed; z-index: 1200; }
}
```

mia: accessibility: popover must be announced as "Menu for run <id>", trap keyboard focus while open, Esc returns focus to the kebab. Also provide aria-labels for icon-only controls.

emma: also found a copy nit: "Retry job" wraps badly on small widths, becomes two lines. Suggest visual icon-only with aria-label="Retry job" and keep full text for screen readers.

a11y-bot: Quick check: ensure role=menu and aria-labelledby are set on popover; add focus management tests.

raj: can we add Percy snapshots at 320/375/412 widths and a cypress e2e that simulates keyboard opening the popover?

lucas: I'll open a small PR with portal popovers + hit area fix + snapshot hooks. tagging @mia for design review and @a11y-bot for checklist.

mia: thanks — will add figma variant for centered popover and short icon labels.

emma: assigning follow-ups in the design board, PR link when ready. :thumbsup:
